data.name: Abideen
data.gender_notes: Abideen is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who abides by the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). This name is derived from the Arabic root 'abd' which means 'servant' or 'worshiper'. Abideen is a name that evokes a sense of spiritual devotion, obedience, and submission to Allah. The name Abideen carries the meaning “Follower of the Prophet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abideen usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of the prophet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes dedication and commitment to the path of Allah.
data.etymology: Abideen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Follower of the Prophet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abideen total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
